question: Which CAPEC patterns map to ATT&CK technique T1114.002 (Remote Email Collection), and what is that technique?

answer.headline: Gathered 4 record(s) from 2 source(s); 1 cross-source correlation(s) on shared identifiers.
answer.narrative: CAPEC-555 (Remote Services with Stolen Credentials) maps to ATT&CK technique T1114.002, carrying an Abstraction of Standard and a Status of Stable, along with one TaxonomyEntry (capec:taxonomy:ATTACK:1114.002). The ATT&CK record T1114.002 is named Remote Email Collection, has a stix_type of attack-pattern, is classified as a subtechnique (x_mitre_is_subtechnique: True) at version 1.3, and has both revoked and x_mitre_deprecated flags set to False. In the MITRE ATT&CK graph, T1114.002 has one related item (TA0009), while its parent technique T1114 (Email Collection) has one related item (T1114.002), and the identifier T1114.002 is corroborated across three records shared between the attack and capec sources.

results.query: MATCH (n:SubTechnique) WHERE n.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WITH n, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE type(r) END AS rel, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE startNode(r) = n END AS outgoing, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE head(labels(m)) END AS neighbour_label, count(m) AS cnt WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN rel IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {rel: rel, outgoing: outgoing, label: neighbour_label, count: cnt} END) AS raw WITH n, [f IN raw WHERE f IS NOT NULL] AS facets RETURN n.attack_id AS id, n.name AS name, n.properties_json AS properties_json, facets AS facets LIMIT 20000

records.name: Remote Email Collection
records.label: SubTechnique
records.description: Adversaries may target an Exchange server, Office 365, or Google Workspace to collect sensitive information. Adversaries may leverage a user's credentials and interact directly with the Exchange server to acquire information from within a network. Adversaries may also access externally facing Exchange services, Office 365, or Google Workspace to access email using credentials or access tokens. Tools such as [MailSniper](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0413) can be used to automate searches for specific keywords.

related.name: Collection
related.description:
The adversary is trying to gather data of interest to their goal.

Collection consists of techniques adversaries may use to gather information and the sources information is collected from that are relevant to following through on the adversary's objectives. Frequently, the next goal after collecting data is to either steal (exfiltrate) the data or to use the data to gain more information about the target environment. Common target sources include various drive types, browsers, audio, video, and email. Common collection methods include capturing screenshots and keyboard input.
